newsitem.title: POLAND: DECISION ON PROCHNIK'S STAKE SALE FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: DECISION ON PROCHNIK'S STAKE SALE FRIDAY.

text.p: A court is likely decide on Friday on whether to sell a 25-percent stake of the garment maker Prochnik SA, held by the receiver of liquidated insurer Westa, to one of the National Investment Funds, Westa's receiver said.
"The decision on the purchase of about 25 percent of Prochnik shares should be taken on Friday," Dorota Brzezinska-Grabarczyk told Reuters.
She said the only offer to buy the stake came from the National Investment Fund No. 12, Piast, one of 15 such institutions created under Poland's mass privatisation scheme.
Brzezinska-Grabarczyk said the court, based in the central city of Lodz, wanted to ask the fund some additional questions before clearing the sale.

The fund is offering to pay 11 zlotys per share, more than 9.19 zloty set by the receiver as the minimum sale price. Prochnik, which has a total of 1.5 million shares outstanding, closed on Wednesday at 10.5 zlotys.
